latest_release.name: v1.13.1: App Store switch keeps your settings, macOS 27 fixes
latest_release.body:
### Added
- Settings › Advanced › "Right-click on the arrow": Show menu (the default, unchanged) or Show always-hidden icons. The second brings back the right-click of Hidden Bar before 1.11, which showed the always-hidden icons like Option-click does, so a Mac used without a keyboard (a TV, a remote) can reach them. The menu then opens with Option-right-click.
- Direct build on macOS 27: when you expand the bar and some of the revealed icons do not fit (on a notched MacBook, right of the notch), macOS puts them into its own « button. Hidden Bar now says so once, after an expand by click or hotkey: "Some icons do not fit in the menu bar, so macOS moved them into its own « button. Click « to see them. To make room, move icons you rarely use to the always-hidden section." It never shows again, and the collapse notice from before stays separate.

### Changed
- Hidden Bar is now published by Console Labs. About, the privacy policy, the README, the App Store listing and the macOS 27 notice name Console Labs and link to console.so or github.com/consolelabs/hidden; the "Follow on X" row is gone from About. The app id, signing identity and update feed are unchanged, so updates and settings carry over.
- The support email shown in About and in the privacy policy is now support@console.so (it was macos@d.foundation).
- Settings › Advanced: the switch "Show all icons while macOS hides one right of the arrow" is now "Pause hiding while macOS shows Now Playing, Focus and similar items", with a note that Hidden Bar hides nothing while one of them shows. Same stored setting, same behavior ([#446](https://github.com/dwarvesf/hidden/issues/446)).

### Fixed
- Switching from the App Store version on macOS 27 (direct build) loses nothing: settings import even when the App Store copy is running at launch, "Open Hidden Bar at login" stays on and opens the new copy (after Import or "Not now"), a failed move of the App Store copy to the Trash says so, and an older direct version (1.8 to 1.12) still running gets "Quit and Switch" instead of a silent quit. The status card says "a temporary folder" instead of a random folder name, and the README, the manual and the macOS 27 notice say to remove the App Store copy before `brew install --cask hiddenbar`. The migration alerts and the macOS 27 notice are now localized.
- macOS 27 (direct build): clicking the clock while the bar is collapsed opens Notification Center again when a notification is still on screen. A notification that stays up across a collapse (such as macOS's "App Background Activity" at login) uses the same window as the panel, so Hidden Bar took it for an open panel and ignored the click. Hidden Bar now checks that the panel itself is open (it has Edit Widgets) before treating a click as one that closes it.
- macOS 14 and later: "Use the full menu bar on expanding" now takes focus. Hidden Bar became a regular app but never the active one, so the front app's menus kept the bar and the option did nothing, in full screen too. It now takes the active state from the front app, and collapsing hands focus back ([#142](https://github.com/dwarvesf/hidden/issues/142)).
- Test runs no longer read or write Hidden Bar's real preferences or act on the installed app. A test host uses its own preferences suite, and skips the "Move to Applications" offer, the App Store migration prompts, Sparkle and the saved arrow positions, so a test run cannot trash or move the installed copy.
- macOS 27 (direct build): Little Snitch's icon no longer hides on every collapse. Little Snitch turns Accessibility off for its apps, so Hidden Bar could not see its icon, left it off the list of apps to keep, and macOS hid it wherever it sat. Hidden Bar now keeps an app it cannot see visible, as it does for an app that does not answer. Its position stays unknown, so to hide it, set it to Hidden in Settings › Icons. This likely also covers [#514](https://github.com/dwarvesf/hidden/issues/514), whose app was not identified ([#502

detail.readme:
## Hidden Bar Hidden Bar lets you hide menu bar items to give your Mac a cleaner look.

## 🚀 Install > **Official downloads.** Console Labs publishes Hidden Bar only through [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/consolelabs/hidden/releases), the Homebrew cask `hiddenbar`, and the [Mac App Store listing](https://itunes.apple.com/app/hidden-bar/id1452453066). Any other site offering Hidden Bar (for example `hiddenbar.app`) is not run by Console Labs. ###  App Store [![AppStore](img/appstore.svg)](https://itunes.apple.com/app/hidden-bar/id1452453066) The App Store build is sandboxed and cannot hide icons on macOS 27. On macOS 27, use the GitHub or Homebrew build below. ### Others The Hidden Bar is notarized before distributed out side App Store. It's safe to use 👍 #### Using Homebrew ``` brew install --cask hiddenbar ``` Coming from the App Store version? Quit it and move `/Applications/Hidden Bar.app` to the Trash first: Homebrew does not install over it. Your settings stay; the new version offers to import them on first launch. #### Manual download - [Download latest version](https://github.com/consolelabs/hidden/releases/latest) - Open and drag the app to the Applications folder. - Launch Hidden and drag the icon in your menu bar (hold CMD) to the right so it is between some other icons. ## 🕹 Usage * `⌘` + drag to move the Hidden icons around in the menu bar. * Click the Arrow icon to hide menu bar items, and click it again to show them. * Option-click the Arrow to reach the always-hidden section, a second group that stays hidden when you click the arrow. * Settings has the hide delay, a global shortcut, other ways to reveal icons (hover, scroll, shake) and the arrow style.

## 📚 Documentation - [Manual](docs/MANUAL.md): every setting, the hidden Terminal-only options, and troubleshooting. - [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the hiding trick works, topology, and known limits. - [Maintainer runbook](docs/RUNBOOK.md): build, behavioral verification, and release process. ## ✨Contributors This project exists thanks to all the people who contribute. Thank you guys so much 👏 [![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/0)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/0)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/1)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/1)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/2)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/2)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/3)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/3)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/4)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/4)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/5)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/5)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/6)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/6)[![](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/images/7)](https://sourcerer.io/fame/phucledien/consolelabs/hidden/links/7) Please read [this](CONTRIBUTING.md) before you make a contribution. ## Requirements macOS version >= 13.0 (Ventura) Running an older macOS? The last release supporting macOS 10.13 High Sierra through 12 Monterey is [v1.10](https://github.com/consolelabs/hidden/releases/tag/v1.10). Later versions require macOS 13 because autostart moved to the `SMAppService` API introduced there. ## You may also like - [Blurred](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1497527363) - A macOS utility that helps reduce distraction by dimming your inactive noise - [VimMotion](https://github.com/consolelabs/VimMotionApp) Vim style shortcut for MacOS ## License MIT © [Console Labs](https://console.so)
